document_api_meta.title: Edit Size Chart V2
document_api_meta.env_desc: Edit an existing seller-owned size chart by replacing its structured table and editable metadata. Omit `template_name` to keep the current template name. The request must identify one authorized shop using shop_cipher.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc: The cipher identifying the authorized shop for this request. Obtain it from Get Authorized Shops and use the value for the shop whose size chart is being created or edited.

request_body_param.name: size_chart_data
request_body_param.desc: Complete replacement size-chart data, including the structured table, measurement type, unit system, and optional descriptive metadata.

request_body_param.name: ^is_one_size
request_body_param.desc: Whether this is a one-size chart.

request_body_param.name: ^measurement_type
request_body_param.desc: Possible values: GENERIC_MEASUREMENTS: generic measurements; BODY_MEASUREMENTS: shopper body measurements; PRODUCT_MEASUREMENTS: finished-product measurements.

request_body_param.name: ^size_types
request_body_param.desc:
Possible values:
- `size_chart_common_size_type`: Common
- `size_chart_size_type_regular`: Regular
- `size_chart_size_type_juniors`: Juniors
- `size_chart_size_type_plus`: Plus
- `size_chart_size_type_big&tall`: Big & Tall
- `size_chart_size_type_petite`: Petite
Available values depend on the category. Values outside this list are not supported.

request_body_param.name: ^table
request_body_param.desc: Structured table containing 1–20 column definitions and 1–45 data rows. Each row must contain exactly one cell for every header, in the same order.

request_body_param.name: ^^^id
request_body_param.desc: Standard size-system ID or measurement key returned by Get Category Rules; omit for custom columns.

request_body_param.name: ^^^name
request_body_param.desc: User-visible header name, with a maximum length of 32 characters. It may be seller-defined, for example `Bust (cm)`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^cells
request_body_param.desc: Cells aligned by index with table.headers.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^value
request_body_param.desc: Default displayed cell value. Maximum length: 32 characters.

request_body_param.name: ^unit_system
request_body_param.desc: Possible values: METRIC: metric units; IMPERIAL: imperial units.

request_body_param.name: size_chart_id
request_body_param.desc: The ID of the seller-owned reusable size chart template to update.

request_body_param.name: template_name
request_body_param.desc: The new name of the size chart template. If omitted, the current name remains unchanged.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: ^size_chart_id
response_param.desc: The ID of the updated size chart. This is the same ID provided in `size_chart_id`.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
